success.description: 6 power, a suitable surface to inscribe the sigil upon and materials to inscribe the sigil with. Effect: You create a ward that undead and ethereal creatures cannot approach; they cannot come within close range while the spell is recharging. Powerful, free-willed undead may make an opposed Discipline (WP) check to ignore the sigil.
